description: Synthetic semantic fixtures. Runtime authorization credentials are deliberately absent; these records cannot grant IPC authority.

cases.name: same-origin-prefixes-keep-distinct-progress
cases.expected: different persistence and queue identities even for identical book bytes

cases.name: https-resource-upgrade-preserves-library-identity
cases.expected: resource may use the permitted HTTPS upgrade while persistence retains the original HTTP base

cases.name: host-and-reader-document-generations-are-separate
cases.expected: source fence uses host generation 17; Reader caller fence and queue use target generation 1

cases.name: same-document-claim-is-idempotent
cases.actualCaller: same backend-bound Reader Webview and exact fixed document
cases.expected: same minimal context and same existing claim; no broader authority

cases.name: same-library-new-launch
cases.expected: same persistent identity and separate runtime queues

cases.name: resource-dispatch-is-single-book-and-read-only
cases.expected: only the exact sealed URL and read-only methods can reserve a Reader resource ticket

cases.name: abort-or-destroy-is-not-resource-settle
cases.observed: AbortController.abort() or JavaScript document destruction without confirmed transport terminal state and settle ACK
cases.expected: ticket remains pending and source remains occupied

cases.name: normal-closing-observes-authoritative-terminal-result
cases.nextControlCall: same actual Reader document, same claim, closing(lastSequence=2)

cases.name: drain-ready-hint-does-not-release-a-source
cases.expected: keep occupancy until the actual same-document closing call returns a terminal reservation

cases.name: lost-save-response
cases.expected: unknown; no mutation replay and no source release

cases.expected: preserve originals without restore or migration into a
